TermRule
PoolAttribute + Skill (+ any bonus dice)
SuccessEach die showing 4, 5, or 6
Difficulty1 Trivial · 2 Easy · 3 Moderate · 4 Hard · 5 Absurd
Partial1+ Successes but short of the target: succeed with a complication
Failure0 Successes: fail, a consequence occurs
CriticalDouble the required Successes: succeed + bonus + Alert −1
BotchPool at 0: roll 1 die. 1–3 fail + Alert +2. 4–6 clean fail.
AssistAdjacent ally rolls Skill only (max 3 dice). Each Success = +1 die.

RuleDetail
Scale1 square = 1 spider. Distances are counted in squares.
SpeedSquares per turn, set by species. Most 5 · Wolf 7 · Jumping 6 · Crab 4.
Your turnMove up to Speed (may split) + one Action. Diagonals count as 1.
AdjacencyThe 8 surrounding squares. Brawl and Assist need adjacency.
CoverA solid object between you and a viewer: +2 Difficulty to spot/target you.
ClimbingNormal cost on walls/ceilings. Slick/hostile surfaces cost double or a roll.
Hurt/CriticalSpeed halved (round down).
Turn orderOnly when timing is tight: crew acts (any order), then the ST's threats.

RuleDetail
Only goes up+1 failed roll w/ consequence, spotted briefly, Silk Clutch · +2 Botch, confirmed alert, spider Out, Loud Failure
Thresholds3–4 Stirring: Stealth +1 · 5–6 Active: threat wakes, no roll penalty · 7–8 Lockdown: all rolls +1 (Stealth +2, stacks) · Limit: Full Alert
ReductionCritical Success only: Alert −1
LimitsEasy 10 · Standard 8 · Hard 6 · Absurd 4 · Legendary 2

Cost/RewardEffect
1 SP+1 die to a roll · run a Silk Line (≤5 squares)
2 SPReroll up to 3 dice · build a web structure · Improvise (Attribute only, +1 Difficulty)
3 SPSilk Clutch (fail → success, Alert +1) · Damage Control (crew: one +2 spike → +1, once/heist)
4 SPNot Part of the Plan (negate one complication, once/heist)
Earn +1Flaw bites · spectacular funny failure · creative species use
Earn +2Genuinely brilliant plan, table agrees, ST confirms

StateEffect
UnharmedFull pool.
Rattled−1 die on all rolls.
Hurt−2 dice, half Speed.
Critical−3 dice, must be assisted to move.
OutRemove from heist. Alert +2. Activate the Waiting Web.
Taking a hitDrop 1 level. Shrug off with BODY+Endurance vs the attack: meet/beat = no drop; lose by 3+ = drop 2. Ties to you.

PhaseSummary
1 — The ScoreST presents the job and the visible map. Roleplay only. No rolls, no Alert.
2 — PlanningCase for intel (a Success = one true detail). Make Preparations (setup, not auto-wins; each gets a complication).
3 — The Heist3–4 obstacles. The Alert climbs. At least one thing the crew didn't uncover.
4 — The Escape1–2 obstacles. Alert carries over. At least one must be solvable without Athletics.
5 — DebriefCount loot, award AP, argue about what happened, take the next job.

Advancement Points

ResultAP
Full SuccessEasy 2 · Standard 3 · Hard 5 · Legendary 8
PartialHalf AP, rounded down
Loss0 AP. Never discussed.
Spending AP1 AP: +1 to a Skill · 2 AP: +1 to an Attribute · 3 AP: a new Perk from your Role list (no maximum)

Good luck out there. The cat is watching. Don't get vacuumed.
